commitResults.messageTitle: Students: Delete by ID or name
commitResults.messageBody:
The inherited index-based delete command does not identify a student by their student record and cannot safely resolve duplicate names.

Accept /id or /name. Delete by name only when it identifies one student, and require the student ID when several students have the same name.

commitResults.messageTitle: Progress: Add student deliverable status model
commitResults.messageBody:
Mark and unmark need a per-student record that distinguishes courses and semesters.

Add immutable progress records with default Not Done statuses and a status update operation. Leave command, storage, and UI integration for later work.

commitResults.messageTitle: Progress: Initialise and persist student deliverables
commitResults.messageBody:
Completion statuses must exist before mark and unmark can update them and must survive application restarts.

Create default progress records as students and courses are added, remove them with deleted students, and persist them in the existing JSON data file.

TAs need to update deliverable completion for a specific student and course-semester.

Add mark and unmark commands with shared validation for student, course, semester, and task inputs. Reject ambiguous and invalid updates.

Keep mark and unmark usage messages aligned with shared prefix constants.

Use the existing duplicate-prefix validation helper to avoid duplicating parser logic.

TAs need to inspect a student's progress for a selected course-semester.

Add a view command that displays each deliverable with its completion status. Validate student and course-semester selection before showing progress.

commitResults.messageTitle: Progress: Reuse shared view parser conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep view progress usage and parser messages aligned with shared prefix constants.

Use the existing duplicate-prefix validation helper to avoid duplicating parser logic.

Unmark should reject invalid input consistently with mark.

Test supported student identifiers, multiple deliverables, missing or conflicting identifiers, unknown prefixes, and empty task values.
